name: BambooHR Thomas2Go Café: Clean-Ingredient Grilled Chicken or Salmon & White Rice / Potato Bowl
brandOrRestaurant: Thomas2Go / Thomas Cuisine Café at BambooHR (Lindon / Draper, UT)
whyItWorks: At the Thomas2Go hot entrée/bowl station, you can build a clean protein plate with herb-grilled chicken breast or salmon over steamed white rice or roasted potatoes with cooked carrots/squash.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask the chef at the hot line for plain grilled chicken or salmon over white rice or mashed/roasted potatoes—skipping fibrous quinoa/wheat-berry bases and raw chimichurri/citrus dressings.
watchOuts: Sub white rice or potatoes in place of quinoa, farro, or wheat berries
Confirm sauces are citrus-free and chili-free
